Before you apply
What is a fit to work certificate?
A fit to work certificate is a short medical note in which a doctor states that, based on the information reviewed, a person is fit to carry out their work.
Employers ask for one when someone joins the company or comes back after an illness. The note records the doctor's opinion on the date of review.
A fit to work certificate does not diagnose a condition. The note also does not approve leave or a return to work by itself, because that decision belongs to the employer.

People also call it a fitness to work certificate, a return to work note, a medical fitness certificate or an employee fitness certificate. On DrCertificate, every one of these goes through the Medical Fitness Certificate option.
When might you need a fit to work certificate?
You might need a fit to work certificate when an employer, school or agency wants a doctor's confirmation that you are well enough to work.
The request usually comes from HR, a recruitment agency or a placement coordinator. A sports club asking for a fitness note uses the same form option.

A different certificate fits better in other cases. If you are still unwell and need time off, a sick leave certificate is the right choice. If you can work but should stay home, ask for a work from home certificate, and if an airline wants clearance for a flight, look at the fit to fly pages.

blocks.text: What do employers, schools or airlines usually expect from a fit to work certificate?

Employers, schools and agencies usually expect a fit to work certificate to name you, show the date of the doctor's review and state plainly that you are fit for work. Most want it from a registered doctor in a readable format.
Rules differ by employer, institution and country. An employer in Manila, Cebu or Davao can follow different rules from a school in Singapore.

Singapore's Ministry of Manpower sets stricter rules for hazardous work. The Ministry says that when a medical examination shows an employee previously removed from exposure is fit for hazardous work, a designated workplace doctor needs to submit a certificate of fitness before that employee returns.

The Ministry also says the medical examination for migrant workers screens for 4 types of infectious diseases and checks if they are fit to work. An online chat review cannot replace either examination.
Before you apply, confirm these points with the recipient.

What will the doctor ask you for a fit to work certificate?
The doctor will ask about your current health, any recent illness and the dates that matter for your work. Clear and consistent answers help the doctor reach a decision sooner.
Expect questions on these topics.

Keep any recent clinic notes or discharge papers ready, since they can help the doctor understand your recovery. The doctor may send follow-up questions in the chat. Answer them accurately, because details that do not match are a common reason for a decline.

blocks.text: Where can a fit to work certificate not be used?
A fit to work certificate from DrCertificate cannot be used for submission in India, for legal purposes or for insurance. Applicants must be at least 16 years old.

The service is for suitable non emergency situations only. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing or another urgent symptom, go to your nearest emergency department or call local emergency services now.
Acceptance is always decided by the recipient.
Check with your employer, school or agency that they accept online medical notes before you apply.
What happens if the doctor cannot issue your fit to work certificate?
If the doctor cannot issue your fit to work certificate, you will not receive one and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2% of requests.

Declines happen when details are wrong, for example when the name and ID do not match, or when the symptoms and details shared are inconsistent. A doctor will also decline when your situation needs an in person examination or tests. Return to hazardous work in Singapore and migrant worker medical examinations both need a designated or examining doctor in person.
The same applies when your recovery can only be judged with a physical check or lab results, so a local clinic is the right place to go.
Payments are non refundable, except for a verified technical fault reported within 24 hours. Questions go to care@drcertificate.com.

blocks.text: Will my employer, school or airline accept a fit to work certificate?
Your employer, school or airline will accept a fit to work certificate only if its own policy allows online medical notes. DrCertificate encourages every applicant to check this before applying.
All doctors on the platform are registered with a medical council. A recipient who wants to verify the issuing doctor can look up the doctor's name and registration with that medical council.
If the recipient insists on its own form, a standard online certificate may not be enough. Ask whether a DrCertificate PDF can be used in place of that form, and apply only once they confirm it can.
Fit to work certificate vs related certificates: which do you need?
A fit to work certificate says you are well enough to work, while a sick leave certificate says you need time off.
Travel notes cause the other common mix up. The fit to fly certificate is often confused with the unfit to travel certificate, which states the opposite outcome.

blocks.text: Frequently asked questions about the fit to work certificate
How long is a fit to work certificate valid?

A fit to work certificate is generally valid for 30 days in most South East Asian countries, since fitness notes usually cover that period. Your employer or school can ask for a more recent note, so check how fresh they want it before you apply.
Can a fit to work certificate be backdated?

The doctor sets the dates on a fit to work certificate from what you share in the form and chat. Enter the date you need and explain why. The doctor decides whether your details support it, and dates cannot be changed after the certificate is issued.
How is the fit to work certificate delivered?

DrCertificate sends an approved fit to work certificate as a PDF to the email address you enter on the form. Turnaround is about 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if the email has not arrived, then contact care@drcertificate.com if it still does not show up.
Can I correct the name or date after the certificate is issued?

No, a fit to work certificate cannot be corrected once it is issued, unless the error came from the medical team. Type your full name as shown on your ID and double check every date before you submit the form.
Can I use a fit to work certificate in my country?

DrCertificate serves Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brunei. The service also covers the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam, plus Cambodia, Laos and Myanmar. A fit to work certificate works there if the recipient accepts online notes. The certificate is not for submission in India, for legal purposes or for insurance.
Is my health information kept private?

Your health details go to the doctor reviewing your fit to work certificate request, who uses them to decide whether to issue it. Share only what the doctor needs for that decision. For questions about how your data is handled, email care@drcertificate.com before you apply.
What hours do doctors review fit to work requests?

Doctors review fitness requests, including fit to work, from 9 am to 9 pm IST Monday to Saturday and 10 am to 8 pm IST on Sunday. A request sent outside those hours waits for the next review window, so apply early if your start date is near.
